title: OK, but not great quality
text: OK, but not great quality. As the saying goes, "you get what you pay for.”  This TV stand was easy to assemble, but has some flaws.  The quality is very low, and the quality control is just not there.  40” TV had to actually be hung off center to be level due to poor quality of mounting stand.  Cable hole location is not designed well so cables look messy.  It does the trick for our 40" Samsung UHD TV, but looks off center, because it really is!  It's just OK.  Directions need a bit of work to make them more clear.
